name: Hoshimi Manako
source:
The protagonist of this story. He is appointed with the role of “savior” by [url=https://vndb.org/c119566]Edea[/url], tasked with the job of saving the world from certain destruction. He is deeply traumatized due to his school-life.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/12/30/kasutera/]official website[/url]]
